## Why This Is Asked
Tests practical understanding of Kleene three-valued logic and how to implement a propagator for arbitrary circuits, a common check in hardware simulators and policy engines.

## Key Concepts
- Three-valued logic (T, F, U) and Kleene tables
- Propagation with fixed-point iteration
- Handling cycles in DAG vs. cyclic graphs

## Code Example
```javascript
function kleeneAnd(a,b){ if(a===false || b===false) return false; if(a===true && b===true) return true; return 'U'; }
function kleeneOr(a,b){ if(a===true || b===true) return true; if(a===false && b===false) return false; return 'U'; }
function kleeneNot(a){ if(a===true) return false; if(a===false) return true; return 'U'; }
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How would you scale this to circuits with hundreds of gates?
- How would you extend to more truth values or probabilistic states?

This question tests extending boolean logic to 3-valued temporally indexed constraints and practical propagation strategies.

- Kleene 3-valued logic with temporal indexing

function tigaImp(A,B){ // A,B in {T,F,U}

}

## Why This Is Asked

Tests ability to design small 3-valued CSPs using realistic policy semantics and to craft a concrete satisfying assignment without forcing F.

## Why This Is Asked
Tests ability to reason with Kleene-style 3-valued logic and design tiny propagators for constraint sets.

## Key Concepts
- 3-valued logic (True, False, Unknown)
- Kleene-style truth tables
- Satisfiability with Unknowns and propagation

## Code Example
```javascript
// simple evaluator sketch
function not3(v){ return v=== 'T' ? 'F' : v==='F' ? 'T' : 'U'; }
function or3(a,b){ if(a==='T' || b==='T') return 'T'; if(a==='F' && b==='F') return 'F'; return 'U'; }
function and3(a,b){ if(a==='F' || b==='F') return 'F'; if(a==='T' && b==='T') return 'T'; return 'U'; }
function imp3(a,b){ // a -> b  is (!a) OR b
  const na = not3(a); if(na==='T' && b==='F') return 'F'; if(na==='T') return b; if(na==='F') return 'T'; return 'U'; }
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How would you implement a propagator to handle larger rule sets?
- How does short-circuiting affect unknown propagation in practice?
